company.name: Legionfarm
company.shortDescription: Legionfarm connects gamers with professional players for in-game training and companionship.
company.description:
Legionfarm lets gamers pay to play with Pro players, helping its customers have more fun playing, and learning how to be a better gamer.

Every month 5,000 gamers spend 1.2M+ dollars to play with1k+ Pros and Legionfarm, take a 35% commission.

Legionfarm Pros monetize their skills by turning their hobbies into real careers. They are the top 0.5% of players.

Legionfarm aims to create the largest number of full-time jobs in the gaming industry
